description: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan University is a private university campus at NH-12, Hoshangabad Road, Jatkhedi, Misrod, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462026, offering programmes across engineering, medicine, law, pharmacy, Ayurveda and allied fields.

website_search_evidence.result: The candidate domain srku.edu.in was directly probed; its canonical homepage is https://www.srku.edu.in/ and identifies Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan University, Bhopal.

courses.name: Ph.D. Programme
courses.eligibility: A qualifying master's degree after a 3-year bachelor's degree with at least 55% marks, or the qualifying master's route after a 4-year bachelor's degree; candidates entering after a 4-year bachelor's degree need at least 75%; M.Phil. candidates with at least 55% are eligible, with stated 5% relaxations for listed categories.
courses.mapping_gap: The official doctoral policy describes a multi-discipline Ph.D. programme but does not establish one single discipline; the career tree has no discipline-neutral doctoral node.

agent_notes: Government listing was independently confirmed in the assigned NIRF 2025 Engineering, Law, Management, Medical, Overall and Pharmacy pages, each showing SARVEPALLI RADHAKRISHNAN UNIVERSITY in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.
The official homepage canonicalizes to https://www.srku.edu.in/ and gives the campus address NH-12, Hoshangabad Road, Jatkhedi, Misrod, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462026.

The official Details of Academic Programmes PDF is a current three-page university catalogue created 2025-10-03; repeated offerings across constituent units were deduplicated into unique programme or branch records while retaining every distinct specialization row.

The official doctoral policy is a separate current catalogue/admission source created 2025-10-06. It establishes a generic multi-discipline Ph.D. programme, duration and eligibility, but does not establish a single doctoral specialization, so no specialization was invented.
No certificate-programme row was present in the official academic-programme catalogue or official programme pages reviewed.

Duration was populated only where the official academic-programme catalogue or doctoral policy explicitly stated it; eligibility was left null for non-doctoral programmes because the reviewed central catalogue did not state programme-specific eligibility.

Normal TLS verification for the expected NIRF, search and official hosts produced the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error. Public GET fallback used curl --insecure only after confirming the expected hostnames; no credentials or private data were sent.
